verdict.rationale:
OneDrive/Graph docs document listing file versions via driveItem-list-versions and describe configurable retention behavior (new version per edit, save, or manual), showing the axis is addressed. However, the evidence never shows a documented restore-version API endpoint, nor concrete retention window numbers (only qualitative 'can be configured').
missing for 10: explicit restore/revert-version API reference, quantified retention window documentation, independent confirmation of restore behavior.
